content.short: Alchemy Pay is a global crypto-fiat payment gateway bridging traditional finance and the crypto economy worldwide.
content.description: Alchemy Pay is a global payment gateway that bridges traditional fiat finance with the cryptocurrency economy in over 170 countries. It provides seamless fiat on and off-ramps, allowing users to buy crypto using local payment methods like cards and bank transfers. Its hybrid payment system enables merchants to accept both fiat and cryptocurrency while settling in local currency. The platform also offers crypto-linked cards for instant global spending. With the upcoming Alchemy Chain, a dedicated Layer-1 for stablecoins, it continues to drive mainstream adoption of digital assets globally.
content.meta: Alchemy Pay bridges fiat and crypto payments for merchants and users worldwide. Discover Alchemy and other Wallet Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
